annotation_type: text-only relation annotations for validation audit; not official test gold
policy: Ordered head-to-tail pair; closed NYT10m relation inventory; supplied-text support includes documented motivated inference, with explicit premises and uncertainty. External entity-specific world facts are kept separate. Empty list means no supported allowed relation. Capital-to-containment and direction conventions are retained. The thesis author confirmed the inference criterion and the B08/N18 additions in chat on 6 October 2026.

annotations.rationale: The text places Turner Field in the Atlanta setting. Sentence 1 locates a statue outside its entrance in Atlanta; sentence 2 links a meeting at the field to a home in an Atlanta suburb. Containment is supported but not stated as directly as a City, Country apposition.
Hawaii Kai is said to be near Honolulu. Near does not establish containment or any other relation in the allowed inventory.
An NBC show mentions an American Express card. Co-mention and product placement in a show do not establish an allowed direct company-to-company relation.
Jeffrey Katzenberg is explicitly called the chief executive of DreamWorks Animation.

The repeated Astoria, Queens apposition and the statement that an operation in Queens is in Astoria support Queens containing Astoria. The neighborhood_of label would require the opposite head-to-tail direction.
Brooklyn appears in the title of a work by Betty Smith. The sentences do not state that she was born, lived, or died there.
Helsinki, Finland identifies Helsinki as a place in Finland. None of the supplied sentences says it is the capital, so the country/capital label is not assigned.

Confirmed on 6 October: the converging institutional and locative context supports Iran containing Tehran under the declared pragmatic inference convention. This is not an explicit containment statement and does not support capital.
The text calls places in Queens New York neighborhoods and lists Queens among New York subdivisions. The New York-to-Queens containment direction is supported.
Sam and Jon are both mentioned in an obituary, but the sentence does not establish a direct parent-child relation between them. No other allowed relation is stated.
Edinburgh, Scotland and the National Library of Scotland / Writers Museum in Edinburgh support Scotland containing Edinburgh. Capital status is not explicitly stated.
Derwin Brown is described as sheriff-elect in DeKalb County. The inventory has no relation for holding that office, and the sentence does not state an allowed person-location relation.
